description: Show AUTOPILOT POSTING (autoposting, the posting refill) for this profile — "is autopilot on?", "what is waiting for review?": whether it is on, its mode (review = each batch of fresh posts waits as drafts for approval; auto = fresh posts are scheduled straight away), WHICH CHANNELS it posts to with each one’s posts per day and posting times, roughly what it costs a day, when it next runs, how many posts are queued, the DRAFTS waiting for approval (id, time, channels, caption, the new image or video), and the notes it learned from reviews. It also names the channels that CANNOT be posted to and why. Read-only, free.
name: get_post_refill
title: Autopilot posting status
